policy: Explicit allowlist of the commands TokenPak supports during beta. A command is supported when it is exercised end-to-end, its failure modes are understood, and its output is measured rather than estimated. Everything else stays reachable — nothing is deleted — but is absent from default discovery so the advertised surface is exactly the surface that works. Every command the parser exposes must appear in exactly one of 'supported' or 'excluded'; a test over the live parser enforces that, so a new verb cannot enter the product without a deliberate classification.

excluded.agent: Fleet orchestration surface. Not part of the single-machine path a beta tester walks.
excluded.aggregate: Telemetry aggregation for multi-host deployments; no single-user story yet.
excluded.alerts: Alerting requires a configured notification channel that beta does not provision.
excluded.attribution: Advanced telemetry analysis; overlaps 'report' and 'savings' for the beta path.
excluded.audit: Governance surface aimed at operators running TokenPak for a team.
excluded.benchmark: Runs live provider traffic and therefore spends real money. Off the beta path by design.
excluded.budget: Spend-guard configuration is unverified end-to-end; a wrong limit silently blocks traffic.
excluded.calibrate: Requires live provider traffic to calibrate against.
excluded.compare: Comparison reporting depends on multiple populated datasets a new install does not have.
excluded.config-check: Superseded by 'doctor' and 'validate' on the beta path; kept for compatibility.
excluded.creds: Credential management is exercised through 'setup' during beta; the standalone verb is not.
excluded.debug: Developer diagnostic. Output is implementation-facing, not user-facing.
excluded.dispatch: Fleet task dispatch. Not a single-machine capability.
excluded.explain: Explanation surface is unverified against the measured-data contract.
excluded.fingerprint: Structural fingerprinting is an internal compression facility, not a user task.
excluded.fleet: Multi-host operation. Explicitly out of beta scope.
excluded.forecast: Projects future spend from history a new install does not have.
excluded.last: Non-functional: a redirect stub with no implementation behind it. Excluded until it returns real data.
excluded.leaderboard: Fleet-comparison surface; meaningless for a single install.
excluded.learn: Learning pipeline is unverified and writes state no other verb reads yet.
excluded.lock: Coordination primitive for concurrent multi-host runs. Out of beta scope.
excluded.monitor: Overlaps 'status' without adding a separately verified view of the same data.
excluded.openclaw: Adapter-specific integration outside the beta client set.
excluded.optimize: Applies changes based on heuristics that have not been measured on the beta path.
excluded.pak: MultiPak surface is a foundation; the pipeline that populates it is not present.
excluded.pakplan: Read-only preview of an unpopulated foundation. Nothing to show a beta tester.
excluded.permissions: Advanced access control for shared deployments.
excluded.prove: Proof-receipt surface requires live provider traffic to prove anything.
excluded.prune: Destructive maintenance on stored state; not verified against the path split.
excluded.recommendations: Emits advice derived from data a new install does not have.
excluded.replay: Replay requires a populated request log.
excluded.requests: Raw request listing is implementation-facing; 'report' is the user-facing view.
excluded.retrieval: Retrieval tuning surface aimed at index operators.
excluded.run: Generic automation runner; not part of the beta path.
excluded.test: Internal test harness. Not a product capability.
excluded.tip: TIP cache administration is an advanced surface; the cache works without it.
excluded.upgrade: Hidden compatibility shim. Public Pro enrollment is unavailable, so there is nothing to advertise.
excluded.usage: Overlaps 'cost' and 'stats' without adding a verified view.
excluded.vault-health: Diagnostic detail folded into 'doctor' for the beta path.
excluded.watch: Not implemented — its own help says to use `tokenpak dashboard` instead. Advertised as a live savings dashboard, which it is not.
